newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends higher in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends higher in dull trading.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed higher at 42.5000/5300 to the dollar in interbank session against the previous 42.5250/5325, dealers said.
The taka was quoted at 42.5200/5350 per dollar in early trade but edged up later on lower demand for the greenback.
"Major players were absent in the market. The market was dull mainly because most international markets were closed for the weekend," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates ended at 7.25 percent to 7.5 percent, against 7.0 to 7.5 percent previously. Friday is the weekend in Bangladesh. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
